title: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986
full_text: Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198668 Act Number: 68 Enactment Date: 1986-12-24 Act Year: 1986 Short Title: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986 Long Title: An Act to provide for the better protection of the interests of consumers and for that purpose to make provision for the establishment of consumer councils and other authorities for the settlement of consumers disputes and for matters connected therewith. Department: Department of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution Enforcement Date: 15-04-1987 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs) Location: Manipur Notification: 15th April, 1987, vide notification No. S.O. 390(E), dated 15th April, 1987 in respect of Chapters I, II and IV, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii). 1st July, 1987, vide notification No. S.O. 568(E), dated 10th June, 1987 in respect of Chapter III, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
